title: Notification event for the Watch app
description: A Notification event as the relay serves it to the Watch app in GET /v1/events (docs/TZ.md §5.4). The relay cuts body to 3000 code points; body_truncated tells the watch to fetch the full text from GET /v1/events/{id}.

then.description: Only a body longer than the limit is cut, so a cut body fills it.
